lines.text: Many learners say: She is tall as her sister.
Better: She is as tall as her sister.
Same size needs as before and after.
As tall as! He is as tall as his dad.

data.wrong: She is tall as her sister.
data.right: She is as tall as her sister.
data.why: Same size needs as before and after.

native.tip: Tiếng Việt nói “cao bằng”, nhưng tiếng Anh cần “as” cả trước lẫn sau.
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “She is tall as her sister.” không? 😄 So sánh bằng cần hai “as”: “She is as tall as her sister.” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “as tall as”. So sánh bạn với một người thân bằng “as…as” nhé! Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: Vietnamese says “cao bằng”, but English needs “as” before and after.
en.caption: Do you often say “She is tall as her sister.”? Say “She is as tall as her sister.” instead. Listen to Carlos, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
